items.summary: In the approved Illinois final proposal, fiber will account for 68.1% of locations; FWA will account for 23.6%; and LEO satellite will snag 8.1% of locations.

items.title: Ciena: CSPs expect AI services and MOFN for revenue growth but they need network upgrades
items.summary: A Ciena survey of CSPs underscores the revenue potential of AI-driven networking.

items.title: T-Mobile says open AI models aren’t just about cost — they’re about fit
items.summary: T-Mobile is experimenting with open and smaller AI models, but don’t expect the carrier to ditch frontier models just yet.

items.title: AT&T moves video up the stack with EdgeVis Cloud
items.summary: AT&T's new EdgeVis Cloud service moves video monitoring to a managed cloud and helps the carrier move beyond mere connectivity.

items.title: Ericsson: Telco edge was early, not wrong — AI may finally make it real
items.summary: The telco edge’s first act flopped, but Ericsson says AI inferencing, robotics and new network capabilities could finally give the edge the oomph it was missing.

items.title: NGMN: Agentic AI needs guardrails before it can run telco networks
items.summary: NGMN says agentic AI could help operators move toward Level 4 autonomous networks, but only if the industry tackles identity, governance, interoperability, security and cost controls first.

items.title: GSMA warns telcos against outsourcing AI future to hyperscalers
items.summary: GSMA says today’s top AI models still don’t understand telecom well enough — and open telco models could be the key to closing the gap.

items.title: Broadcom sees hyperscalers sidelining telcos for some scale across projects
items.summary: Telcos want to bring together fiber, optical line systems, switches and services needed to connect massive GPU clusters in disparate data centers.

items.title: Verizon cozies up to Google Cloud even more with Gemini integration
items.summary: Verizon is deepening its Google Cloud ties with Gemini Enterprise, betting AI can clean up customer care, network issues and marketing workflows.

items.title: T-Mobile’s rock star status gets Wall Street remix
items.summary: Does one Wall Street analyst’s downgrade mean T-Mobile is toast? Not quite, but Big Magenta’s longstanding “value” proposition is clearly under pressure.

items.title: Zayo inks long-term fiber supply deal with Corning
items.summary: The deal secures most of the fiber Zayo needs for its planned expansion.
